reddit.body: Hey — I built SVGMotion, a free AI-assisted SVG animation studio. What it does: you describe a scene, it generates editable layers + keyframes, and you export a plain `.svg` file. The animation is baked into the markup — it plays in any `` tag with no player JS, no Lottie JSON. Why I built it: I wanted Rive-style iteration without the runtime dependency or the pricing. Stack notes: browser-native ES modules, BYOK AI (Ollama/OpenRouter/OpenAI), local-first storage in IndexedDB. Fully open source. Site: https://meesai.net/svgmotion/ Live editor: https://app.svgmotion.workers.dev/ Source: https://github.com/saidevac Feedback welcome — especially on the export format.

title_options: Show HN: SVGMotion — AI SVG animation studio that exports runtime-free .svg files
Show HN: Local-first AI SVG animator — export plain .svg, no player needed
showhn.text:
Hi HN — I built SVGMotion, an AI-assisted SVG animation studio.

The pitch: describe a scene, edit the generated layers/keyframes/physics, and export a plain .svg file. The animation is baked into the markup — plays anywhere an SVG renders, zero runtime.

It's local-first (browser IndexedDB), open source, and the AI is BYOK — works fully offline with Ollama.

Editor: https://app.svgmotion.workers.dev/
Product page: https://meesai.net/svgmotion/

Happy to answer questions about the baking/export approach.
